facts.fact: Saskia 站在浴室镜子前盯着自己。
facts.anchor: Saskia stares in her bathroom mirror.

facts.fact: Saskia 从自己身上摘出种子：腹股沟的褶皱里两颗、睫毛上三颗、指甲缝里四颗。
facts.anchor: She has pulled two seeds from the tender fold of her groin, three from her eyelashes, four from under her fingernails.

facts.fact: Saskia 打算找借口躲开 Lucy。
facts.anchor: She will make excuses to stay away from Lucy.

facts.fact: 她醒来时站在 Lucy 上方，手里握着 Lucy 家最大的厨房刀。
facts.anchor: And then she woke up standing over Lucy, holding Lucy’s biggest kitchen knife in her hand.

facts.fact: 门口的 Lucy 浑身是血。
facts.anchor: Lucy, not in the sky with diamonds, but covered in blood.

facts.fact: Lucy 说自己是切胡萝卜时切到了指甲。
facts.anchor: “I was cutting carrots and got my fingernail.”

facts.fact: Lucy 轻声说她在给 Saskia 熬汤。
facts.anchor: “I’m making soup,” Lucy says softly as Saskia unwraps her finger.

facts.fact: Lucy 说警察上门是因为他们认为找到了她母亲的遗体。
facts.anchor: “The police—that’s why they were here. They think they found—her—her body.”

facts.fact: Saskia 告诉 Lucy 她不蠢，说她蠢的人才是混蛋，哪怕那个人是她自己。
facts.anchor: “You are not stupid, and whoever told you that you were stupid is an asshole, even if the asshole is you,” Saskia says as gently but firmly as she can.

facts.fact: Lucy 极轻地解下 Saskia 的口罩挂带，指尖划过她的耳廓，让她脊背发麻。
facts.anchor: So, so gently, Lucy pulls the straps of the mask away, her fingertips sending shivers down Saskia’s spine as they trace the shells of her ears.

facts.fact: Lucy 踮起脚，把嘴唇贴上 Saskia 的嘴。
facts.anchor: Then she goes up on her tiptoes and presses her lips to Saskia’s mouth.
